<p style="text-align: justify;">
I’m Niklas, a researcher and statistical programmer at the University Medical Center Utrecht. 
</p>

I recently completed my PhD, where I specialized in population registry linkage to address environmental public health questions.
Currently, I am a member of the Real-World Evidence (RWE) Group within the Department of Data Science and Biostatistics. 
</p>
